c74object.name: touch.ummanu
c74object.digest: Touch-First Multi-Category Menu and Browser Component
c74object.description: A unified Max jsui/v8ui UI component designed for tactile hardware, touch screens, and mice. Operates by default as an immediate left/right touch picker with auto-repeat hold stepping and scrub gestures, or expands into a centered floating dropdown list. Supports multi-category preset/device browsing with a dedicated Max background data inlet.

inlet.description: Receives integers or floats to directly select item indices (0 to N-1) within the active category page. Receives bang to output the current selection. Also accepts configuration and theme attribute messages.

Dedicated background data feed. When multimenu and Menu dropdown mode are enabled, receives append, set, clear, folder_menu, or raw filename lists from folder to populate pages asynchronously without interfering with active selections.

outlet.description:
Outputs the selection formatted according to output_type:
0 = Prefix + Item (Default list [Prefix Item], formatted without trailing colons, ready for route).
1 = Raw File (Raw target name, e.g. synth.patch.maxpat for pcontrol).
2 = Item Name (Untouched display label string).
3 = Prefix + Index (List [Prefix Index]).
Outputs the active menu item index (0 to N-1) within the current category page.
Outputs the current category / menu page index (0 to M-1) to drive folder routers and subpatcher selectors.

method.name: bang
method.description: Outputs the current selection through Outlet 0, local item index through Outlet 1, and active page index through Outlet 2.

method.name: int
method.description:
On Inlet 0: Selects the item index in the active menu and updates the canvas and open dropdown synchronously.
On Inlet 1: Switches the active MultiMenu category page.

method.name: float
method.description: Truncates float to integer and selects the item index on Inlet 0.

method.name: append
method.description: Appends an item or filename to the active menu page (Inlet 1 in MultiMenu mode).

method.name: set
method.description: Replaces item at the specified index with a new display and raw filename.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes all items from the active category page.

method.name: menu
method.description: Switches the active category page to the specified index (0 to M-1). Also accepts the alias page.

method.name: folder_menu
method.description: Populates a designated page with a list of filenames or items streamed from folder.

method.name: clear_folders
method.description: Resets all dynamic folder menu pages back to their initial default items.

method.name: popup
method.description: Opens, closes, or toggles the floating parameter inspector window. An optional argument of 1 or 0 explicitly opens or closes the window.

method.name: update
method.digest: Refresh theme from bus or persistent store
method.description: Forces the component to reload and re-render its visual styling from the global wireless theme bus or persistent dictionary store. Also accepts aliases theme_update and refresh_theme.

attribute.name: mode
attribute.description:
Selects operational interaction mode:
0 = Touch (Default) — Click left half to decrement, right half to increment, scrub horizontally, hold to auto-repeat.
1 = Menu — Spawns the floating centered dropdown list.

attribute.name: multimenu
attribute.description: When enabled (1), activates multi-category browsing, pagination chevron arrows, vertical swipe paging, and Inlet 1 folder data reception. When disabled (0), behaves as a lean, single-category touch picker.

attribute.name: output_type
attribute.description:
Determines how Outlet 0 formats data:
0 = Prefix + Item (Default) — Outputs list [Prefix Item] formatted without trailing colons.
1 = Raw File (pcontrol) — Outputs raw target filename.
2 = Item Name — Outputs untouched display string.
3 = Prefix + Index — Outputs list [Prefix Index].

attribute.name: touch_output
attribute.description:
Output trigger behavior in Touch mode:
0 = Instant (Scrub) — Fires immediately upon each step or horizontal drag scrub.
1 = Staged (Safe for pcontrol) — Arms selection visually with highlight underlay; only fires upon center tap confirmation.

attribute.name: show_markers
attribute.description: Displays subtle vertical divider notch marks (or zone gates in staged mode) indicating the separation between decrement and increment touch zones.

attribute.name: hold_speed
attribute.description: Repeat step interval in milliseconds when holding down the mouse button in Touch mode (after initial 350 ms hold gate).

attribute.name: show_arrow
attribute.description: Enables or disables the down-arrow chevron glyph displayed on the canvas when in Menu mode.

attribute.name: selected
attribute.description: Active item index within the currently loaded category page (0 to N-1).

attribute.name: prefix
attribute.description: Category titles (separated by spaces or commas). In MultiMenu mode, each title corresponds to a separate browseable page.

attribute.name: modes
attribute.description: Fallback item list for the menus. Supports unquoted space-delimited words and quoted multi-word strings (e.g. ItemA ItemB "Item C"). Pages are separated by commas.

attribute.name: allow_popup
attribute.description: Enables top-right launcher dot and right-click access to open the floating parameter inspector window.

attribute.name: case_mode
attribute.description:
Text capitalization normalization:
0 = First Cap (Title Case)
1 = All Cap (Uppercase)
2 = All Small (Lowercase)

attribute.name: label_mode
attribute.description:
Controls text abbreviation algorithms for the prefix label:
0 = Full (full string rendered)
1 = No Vowels (removes inner vowels while preserving first letters)
2 = Caps Only (extracts capital letters and digits; falls back to initials)
3 = First Letter (extracts the initial letter of each word)
4 = No Text (suppresses prefix text completely)

attribute.name: corner_radius
attribute.description: Rounding radius of the body container and reticle corner brackets.

attribute.name: bordersize
attribute.description: Stroke line width of the outer reticle corner brackets.

attribute.name: border_extension
attribute.description: Length in pixels of the straight bracket arms extending along edges from each corner arc.

attribute.name: font_name
attribute.description: Font family used for rendering button prefix labels, active items, and dropdown entries.

attribute.name: fontsize
attribute.description: Base point size of the rendered label and item text (clamped $\ge 6$).

attribute.name: bgcolor
attribute.description: RGBA fill color of the main body container.

attribute.name: bordercolor
attribute.description: RGBA stroke color of the reticle corner brackets and zone divider ticks.

attribute.name: highlight_color
attribute.description: RGBA color of the dropdown active selection underlay, staged confirm bar, and chevron glyph.

attribute.name: mode_color
attribute.description: RGBA color dedicated to the prefix category text, decoupled from the active item text color.

attribute.name: textcolor
attribute.description: RGBA color of the primary menu item text on the canvas and in the dropdown list.

attribute.name: popup_dot_color
attribute.description: RGBA color of the top-right launcher dot used to open the parameter inspector.

attribute.name: pop_bgcolor
attribute.description: RGBA background color of the floating parameter inspector window and dropdown list.

attribute.name: attr_bg_color
attribute.description: RGBA background fill color for individual 50/50 attribute rows.

attribute.name: attr_border_color
attribute.description: RGBA outline color for attribute row containers and value boxes.

attribute.name: attr_slider_color
attribute.description: RGBA active fill color for sliders inside the 50/50 attribute inspector.

attribute.name: attr_text_color
attribute.description: RGBA text color for attribute names and value labels inside the inspector.

attribute.name: show_settings_attrs
attribute.description: Master toggle to show or hide the 50/50 attribute list inside the pop-up inspector window.

attribute.name: mask_performance
attribute.description: Toggles visibility of the Mode, MultiMenu, Output Type, Touch Out, Markers, Hold Speed, and Arrow Glyph controls in the pop-up inspector.

attribute.name: mask_labels
attribute.description: Toggles visibility of the Prefix Label Style and Prefix Case Style controls in the pop-up inspector.

attribute.name: mask_geometry
attribute.description: Toggles visibility of the Border Radius, Border Thickness, and Border Extension sliders in the pop-up inspector.

attribute.name: mask_colors
attribute.description: Toggles visibility of the Background, Border, Highlight, Text, Mode Prefix, and Popup Dot color swatches in the pop-up inspector.

attribute.name: mask_popup_colors
attribute.description: Toggles visibility of the 5-color Inspector Theme Palette section in the pop-up inspector.
